account.title: Your account
account.roleMemberHint: You can use the study planner. Editing is limited to approved editors.

password.setBody: We will email a secure link to {email} so you can choose a password.
password.sent: Check your email for a link to set your password.
password.changeBody: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
password.genericError: We could not update your password. Please try again.
password.changedSignedOut: Your password has been changed. Your other devices were signed out.

account.roleVerifyHint: Your email is on the editor list. Verify it to get edit access.

verification.sent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
verification.genericError: We could not send the email. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Deleting your account permanently removes it and the study data stored with it. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmBody: We will email a confirmation link to {email}. Open it while you are signed in to finish. Nothing is deleted until you do.
delete.sent: Confirmation link sent to {email}. It works for one hour. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
delete.genericError: We could not start the deletion. Please try again.

emailVerified.title: Email verification
emailVerified.successBody: Thank you. Your email address is now verified.
emailVerified.expiredBody: Verification links work for 24 hours. Sign in and request a new one from your Account page.
emailVerified.invalidBody: The link may have been used already or copied incompletely. Sign in and request a new one from your Account page.

accountDeleted.title: Account deleted
accountDeleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your account and the study data stored with it have been removed. Thank you for using Project Cherenkov.
